description:
Build the coverage plan from LLMDB and the current package architecture before broadening implementation.

Scope:
- inventory current Anthropic and OpenAI model families exposed by LLMDB that are realistic near-term targets
- group them by semantic family, wire shape, transport shape, and notable capability differences
- identify which differences should be modeled as ExecutionSurface differences versus policy-rule overrides versus adapters
- pick a curated anchor set for live testing and fixture recording
- define what "supported" means for this pass at the scenario level

Output:
- a concrete provider/model matrix for this pressure-test phase
- a short list of expected edge cases for each provider lane
- dependencies and assumptions for downstream implementation tasks
title: Catalog Anthropic and OpenAI target surfaces from LLMDB
